live: a button that states the download size fetches the model's weights and tokenizer from huggingface.co and the ONNX runtime from this site, checks each file's SHA-256, embeds the question you type in your browser (the question is never sent anywhere), and runs the step's vector search with that vector in place of the stored one on the page's database in your browser; nothing downloads before the press.
text:
The element embeds a typed question with the model that made these vectors: [bge-small-en-v1.5](https://huggingface.co/Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5/tree/ea104dacec62c0de699686887e3f920caeb4f3e3) at revision `ea104da`, with CLS pooling, normalized, as its half-precision ONNX weights. The button downloads 82 MB: the weights (66.7 MB) and the tokenizer (0.7 MB) from huggingface.co, and the ONNX runtime (14.2 MB) from this site. Nothing downloads before the press, and each file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is used. The question, at most 200 characters, is embedded in the browser tab and never sent anywhere.

Step `context` then runs with its first line, `MATCH (question:Question {text: $q})`, replaced by `WITH {embedding: vector($embedding, 384, FLOAT32)} AS question`, so `question.embedding` is the typed question's vector and every other line runs as written.

Step `context`'s recorded result, for the stored question "stop the model from deleting nodes":

| Keep an agent safe | ["Verify","Turn on safe mode","Permission matrix","Control network egress"] | 0.8147 | ["Install relate"] | ["checkpoint: The step that writes a fresh snapshot of committed state and recycles old WAL segments: every 300 seconds by default, on clean exit, and on `.checkpoint`.","MCP: The Model Context Protocol, which agent hosts use to call tools; `relate serve --mcp` exposes a store as `read_cypher`, `get_schema` and `write_cypher`.","read-only: An open mode (`--read-only`) that never writes, checkpoints or migrates the store; writes fail, and a directory store can be read beside its writer.","safe mode: An opt-in policy (`--safe`) that refuses a new named node without a label, an unbounded `MATCH` read and a remote `--load`, before anything runs.","store: A relate database: a directory, a single `.rl` file, or `:memory:`, opened with `--database`."] |
| Python API | ["Open options"] | 0.8028 | [] | ["client: A language package that runs the relate engine inside a program's process: the Python, Node.js, Rust, Java, Go and Swift clients.","node: An entity in the graph: it carries zero or more labels and a map of properties, and relationships connect it to other nodes.","path: An alternating sequence of nodes and relationships that a pattern matched, bound with `p = …` and read with `nodes(p)`, `relationships(p)` and `length(p)`.","relationship: A directed, typed connection between two nodes, with properties of its own; every relationship has exactly one type and a start and an end node.","store: A relate database: a directory, a single `.rl` file, or `:memory:`, opened with `--database`."] |
